title: NVIDIA AI Outscored Every Human at IOI 2026: How GenCorrect Made It Possible
description: NVIDIA IOI 2026: NVIDIA's Nemotron-3-Ultra-CC AI scored 535.4 out of 600 at the 37th International Olympiad in Informatics in Tashkent, Uzbekistan, outscoring every human contestant by more than 37 points via GenCorrect, a feedback-driven test-time compute strategy that works only where automated pass-fail verification is instant and costless.

title: Keyaa Banerji’s 140kg triumph turns into online nightmare as AI abuse follows silver medal
description: Indian powerlifter Keyaa Kunal Banerji’s stunning 140kg deadlift silver medal at the 2026 IPF World Sub-Junior and Junior Classic Powerlifting Championships turned into a disturbing online controversy after she alleged AI-generated fake images, impersonation and harassment following her viral performance.

title: TCS Subsidiary HyperVault to Invest INR 70,000 Crore in Massive Hyderabad AI Data Centre Campus
description: TCS subsidiary HyperVault and its partners plan to invest up to INR 70,000 crore to develop a 1GW AI data centre campus in Hyderabad, Telangana. The project will span 264 acres and support high-density GPU deployments for AI workloads. The investment comes as TCS expands its capabilities and diversifies into specialised technology services.

title: Local filmmaker uses AI to produce music video
description: A Los Angeles filmmaker used AI to produce a music video, compressing the gap between idea and execution. Effects that once required large teams can now be produced by a single operator.

title: IAS India’s Ashish Trivedi: Independent measurement is key as AI reshapes digital advertising
description: Ashish Trivedi, Business Development at IAS India, explains why brands need independent verification as ad spending shifts to closed platforms and quick commerce. He discusses the growing risks from AI-generated content, ad fraud, and brand safety, while highlighting why real-time measurement will become even more important as video and commerce continue to grow. How should marketers prepare for this shift?
